release.note: This file records acquisition of documents that are NOT in corpus-v1. It does not change the frozen release and is not itself a corpus input.

scope: Re-attempt of the 13 document identities that the v1 release records as unreachable: nine NRC valve reports and four documents on hosts that refused programmatic download (cdc.gov, publications.usace.army.mil, media.defense.gov x2).

blocked_at_cdn_edge.evidence: All four assigned hosts reject this egress at the CDN edge, not per file: https://www.cdc.gov/ , https://media.defense.gov/ , https://www.publications.usace.army.mil/ and https://stacks.cdc.gov/ all return HTTP 403 Akamai 'Access Denied' (errors.edgesuite.net reference) even for their homepages. https://archive.org/ , https://www.energy.gov/ , https://www.osha.gov/ , https://www.wbdg.org/ , https://www.msha.gov/ , https://usace.contentdm.oclc.org/ return 200.

nrc.evidence: GET https://www.nrc.gov/docs/ML0403/ML040360264.pdf -> HTTP 403, 402-byte HTML 'Access Denied' with reference #18.e771302.1794263193.2a42ea49 (errors.edgesuite.net); HEAD identical; browser UA, nrc.gov Referer, and --http1.1 all 403; https://www.nrc.gov/ -> 200. Index page https://www.nrc.gov/reading-rm/doc-collections/nuregs/contract/cr6478/index -> 301 then 403.

method.recovery_transport: Direct origin fetch first; then Wayback Machine playback (public web archive, no credential or access-control bypass). Wayback raw-stream modifier 'id_' returned HTTP 429 for these PDFs (throttled), while normal playback served original bytes with Content-Type application/pdf and correct sizes.
method.browser_retry: A managed Chromium load of https://www.nrc.gov/docs/ML0402/ML040230128.pdf returned the same Akamai "Access Denied" page, so the block is not a tool user-agent artefact.
method.validation_gate: Every saved file: written to a .tmp name, validated with pdfinfo (parse + page count) and pdftotext (text layer, word count), then renamed. SHA-256 and byte count recorded for each. Acceptance also required an HTTP 200, a %PDF- header, >200 kB, and a trailing %%EOF, with two truncated 5,242,880-byte Wayback captures rejected and re-fetched.
method.reuse_rule: Internet availability is not reuse permission. Every identity carries licence_status=pending_ingest_check and must pass the per-document licence check before it can enter a corpus.
